post.description:
Run one framework directly as a one-stage ``adhoc`` cycle.

Same engine, persistence and event stream as a named cycle: progress and
status live under ``/cycle-executions/{execution_id}``.

Computed on-demand from each run's own artifact snapshot every request (no
caching): extracts both snapshots into a temp dir and matches cases by
historyId/fullName/uuid, same as the CLI's full (non ``--metrics-only``) diff.

post.description:
Record JUnit XML files as one run of *cycle*. Nothing in the upload is executed.

``exit_code`` follows ``testo run``: 0 when every test passed or was skipped,
1 when one failed. Needs ``Authorization: Bearer <TESTO_API_TOKEN>`` when the
server has a token set, like every other write.
